subHeader: How to activate numerical frequencies for healing and manifestation.

steps.caption: SET YOUR INTENTION
steps.description: State clearly what you want to manifest or heal.

steps.caption: REPEAT THE CODE 45 TIMES
steps.description: Say the exact number 45 times (e.g., Code 520 for Money). | | You can say it out loud, silently, or break down digits | | (Five-Two-Zero or Five Hundred and Twenty).

steps.caption: USE A COUNTING STRING
steps.description: Use a necklace or bracelet with 45 beads to stay on track | | without losing focus by counting manually.

steps.caption: CLOSE WITH GRATITUDE
steps.description: Seal the intention by saying: "Thank you, it is done."
